title: Why is a service missing online or showing no times?
summary: Check publication, visibility, eligibility, assignments, hours and booking rules in order.

sections.title: If the service is missing entirely
sections.body:
1. In **Business setup**, confirm the booking page is published and **Accept online bookings** is enabled.
2. In **Services**, open the service. It must be active, within its available dates and have **Enable online booking** selected.
3. In **Team & locations**, confirm an active eligible location and a qualified active person who is enabled online at that location.
4. In Team & availability, check the person’s **Clients can choose them online** setting.
5. Review **Who can book** and the business’s **New clients** rule. A client may be ineligible for a particular service.

sections.title: If the service appears but no times are offered
sections.body:
1. Check location opening hours and the person’s working hours in the location’s time zone.
2. Review breaks, dated temporary hours, time off and closures.
3. In **Booking & rules**, review **Minimum booking notice** and **Book up to (days ahead)**.
4. Check the full duration, cleanup and any required rooms or equipment. Existing appointments, temporary reservations and work at another branch can occupy capacity.
5. Try a different day or qualified person after correcting configuration. Do not reduce the duration merely to force a time to appear.

sections.title: If confirmation stops at a deposit
sections.body: Online deposit payment is not yet available for completing deposit-required public bookings. The client should contact the business. Review whether your policy should require a public deposit; do not tell clients they have a confirmed appointment without a confirmation.

sections.title: Verify the correction
sections.body: Use the actual published booking link and follow the same location, services, person and date as the client. A private preview verifies presentation, not available times. Ask for the visible message and choices used; never request the client’s password or another client’s secure link.
